evidence.note: Clean serif title, sans subtitle and italic byline with ample space; the same nav, kicker and title treatment carries through every slide.
Triangle loop diagram is uncluttered and purposeful: coloured green/red reward paths, check badges, and a definition tile sitting directly under the diagram it explains.
Insight overlay uses a consistent card style with a blurred backdrop, repeated identically on s-4 step 7 and s-5 step 9.

Numbered timeline, fan diagram and source quote tile are well separated with consistent label styling; the quote tile sits far right, some distance from the diagram, and the area right of the public-internet zone is empty.
Coordinator tree card is clean, with three evenly sized boxes and a neat curved-arrow hierarchy.

Busiest step: folder grid, coordinator dots, sacrificed dots, document icon and scorer box crowd the lower fan; the scorer box overlaps the ends of the fan lines, and the 'never read transcripts' label runs past the right edge of the servers panel.
Three evenly built insight cards with a consistent heading, bullet, italic quote and source-link hierarchy; a faint blurred ghost of the previous diagram shows through behind the middle card.
Closing slide mirrors the title slide's styling and background, so the deck ends consistently.

rationale: Typography, colour, cards, overlays and diagram language are consistent and considered throughout, and most diagrams are uncluttered and purposeful. The s-5 final timeline step falls clearly below the rest: crowded elements near the scorer and a label that overruns the panel. That matches level 4, 'considered throughout, with one or two slides below the rest'.
